records.question: What equipment does Executive Order No. 002-2001 prohibit using for fishing?
records.ground_truth_answer: It prohibits the use of underwater birlathing apparatus (SCUBA, HOOKAH AND REBREATHERS) for fishing.
ground_truth_chunks:
EXECUTIVE ORDER No. 002 -2001

AN ORDER PROHIBITING THE USE OF UNDERWATER BIRLATHING APPARATUS (SCUBA, HOOKAH AND REBREATHERS) FOR FISHING

Whereas, a Coral Reef workshop in American Samos conditiled, "Over—fishing is a serious and urgent problem on coral reefs in American Samos." A major contributor to this problem is souba fishing which should no prohibited in all territorial fisheries...
